units.titles: LMSR Saturation Enables Free Share Minting and Vault Theft
units.known_address_notes: Zokyo May-2026 GoMarket report (77 MB, LFS) explicitly frames the codebase as Solana ('Solana network's fast-paced environment'), contradicting the corpus chain 'Sei'; finding is an LMSR saturation bug, so the audited code is an on-chain LMSR market/vault program. Report has no program ID, no repo and zero 0x addresses (only Zokyo gist links for PoCs); gomarket.xyz is a parked/for-sale domain; no Sei or Solana deployment found. Program ID unpublished.
